recursion_rule: A complex type is not expanded below an element whose path already holds an element of the same type: the element is recorded with recursive=true. Object elements below a group or shape tree are recorded (object=true) and expanded only as roots. Slide transitions, timing and background are recorded (stop) but not expanded. xsd:any is one item named *. Value types (colours, gradient and pattern fill bodies, effect containers, 3D, list-style levels, blips) are enumerated once under a pseudo-root "(type)"; at each position only the element is an item, with factored naming the pseudo-root.

items.stop: the slide background is not part of the diagram model
